{{Top|leg}}
'''Harmony Hall''' was a concert hall located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. One of the most prestigious concert halls found on the planet, it was built during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and continued to service the public throughout the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].
